vp-eng: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: two asks for the runtime team - clarify hosted p95 target and define rollback gates for kernel/batching/cache rollouts. Keep it short. @maya-eng-runtime @alex-eng-sre

maya-eng-runtime: Hosted target: p95 token latency <200ms for standard tier. Dedicated target: p95 <150ms under committed load.

alex-eng-sre: Rollback gates (proposal): p95 increase >10% vs baseline OR error-rate increase >0.5% in 1h -> auto rollback. Also watch for OOMs/GPU resets. Canary windows min 24h.

jamal-ml: Note: kernel changes can shift latency distribution by sequence length. We'll publish a short matrix mapping model families to expected perf deltas before canary.

sophia-product: For product notes: will Dedicated customers be able to pin variants? Need a one-liner for release doc.

maya-eng-runtime: Yes — Dedicated customers can pin per-route. One-liner: "Dedicated customers can pin model variants to avoid automatic runtime updates."

vp-eng: Perfect. Action items: eng-runtime publish the rollout doc + matrix by Thu; eng-sre add monitors and runbook; product draft the customer blurb. Tag me on PRs. :+1:
